structure.archiveBody: It leaves the map, and so does everything filed beneath it. Nothing is deleted, and it can be restored from this screen.
structure.archivedHint: Off the map, and so is everything beneath it. Nothing was deleted.
structure.depthCap: The map goes 6 levels below a track and no further, so nothing can be added under this one. Move the branch higher up first.
structure.emptyHint: The tree hangs beneath a track, so there is nothing to build until the workspace has one. Add a track first, then come back.
structure.hisHint: The system this hospital runs, from the catalogue. Rhapsody is not on the list — it is the engine interfaces are built in, not something a hospital runs.
structure.loadFailed: The structure could not be loaded.
structure.managerSet: ⁨{owner}⁩ is now the account manager for ⁨{name}⁩

moveCountEntries.one: 1 item of work is filed beneath it.
moveCountEntries.other: {count} items of work are filed beneath it.

structure.moveCountFailed: What this move would touch could not be counted, so it cannot be described before you commit to it. Reload the screen first.

moveCountNodes.one: 1 item on the map moves with it.
moveCountNodes.other: {count} items on the map move with it.

structure.moveCounting: Working out what this move would touch…
structure.moveCrossTrack: It leaves ⁨{from}⁩ for ⁨{to}⁩, and every piece of work beneath it changes track with it.
structure.moveNoEntries: No work is filed beneath it.
structure.moveNowhere: There is nowhere else this can go: every other place would put it underneath itself or push the branch past the 6 levels a track allows.
structure.moveSameTrack: It stays on ⁨{track}⁩, so no work changes track.
structure.nameArHint: Shown while the app is in Arabic. Leave it empty to fall back to the English name.
structure.nameRequired: Give it an English name of 60 characters or fewer.
structure.restoredHidden: ⁨{name}⁩ is back, but something above it is still archived, so the map will not draw it yet.
structure.settingsHint: Build the tree beneath each track and say who is accountable for each part of it.
structure.subtitle: The tree beneath each track — programmes, phases and the organizations being onboarded. What you build here is what the map draws, and what a piece of work can be filed under.
structure.title: Structure
structure.trackArchivedHint: This track is put away, so the map draws none of what is beneath it. It is listed here because this screen is the only place the branch can be moved somewhere it will be seen.
structure.vendorHint: The company doing the integration. Free text — leave it empty when there is none to record.
